description.text:
A special set for the 25th anniversary of Pokémon and of the trading card game, released on 8 October 2021 and sold only in special collections, in packs of four cards. Its 25 new cards gather Legendary, Mythical and much-loved Pokémon, among them Mew, Ho-Oh and Zamazenta, with Flying Pikachu and Surfing Pikachu as Pokémon V and VMAX.

Beside them is the Classic Collection, 25 reprints of classic cards from earlier years that keep their original numbers, from Base Set's Charizard and Imposter Professor Oak to Shining Magikarp, Umbreon ☆, Luxray GL LV.X and M Rayquaza-EX.
